name: GLM-4-Instruct-8K-zhtw
description: GLM-4-Instruct-8K-zhtw is an 8K-example instruction-following dataset in Traditional Chinese intended for fine-tuning/benchmarking instruction-tuned LLMs (GLM-style). It measures a model's ability to follow prompts and produce appropriate, helpful outputs in zh-TW across a variety of short instruction types. Typically used to evaluate improvements from instruction tuning in Traditional Chinese.
reputation: A targeted instruction-tuning resource for Traditional Chinese; modest adoption but useful for zh-TW fine-tuning experiments.
